# AU Corporate

> AU Corporate is a business advisory and accounting firm based in New Delhi, India, founded in 2016. It helps foreign companies enter, incorporate, and operate in India — company formation, FEMA/RBI and tax compliance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, Virtual CFO services, and related regulatory advisory.

Primary services: India market entry and Global Capability Center (GCC) advisory, assurance and accounting (IFRS/Ind AS), taxation and transfer pricing, FEMA and RBI regulatory compliance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, Virtual CFO services, HR outsourcing, risk and transaction advisory, business valuation, and arbitration/dispute resolution.

Contact: partner@theaucorp.com | +91-9999010513 | New Delhi, India

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.theaucorp.com/): Overview of AU Corporate's services and India market entry proposition
- [Doing Business in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/doing-business-in-india): Guide to entering and operating in India, from market entry through post-incorporation compliance
- [India Business Setup](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-business-setup): Company formation, FDI routes, regulatory compliance, and banking/taxation for new entities
- [Services](https://www.theaucorp.com/services): Full service catalog — taxation, accounting, HR, risk, transaction advisory
- [Taxation & Regulatory](https://www.theaucorp.com/services/taxation-regulatory): Tax planning, GST compliance, tax audit, transfer pricing
- [Accounting & Assurance](https://www.theaucorp.com/services/accounting-assurance): Financial statement preparation, IFRS/Ind AS compliance, internal controls
- [HR Services](https://www.theaucorp.com/hr-services): Payroll, HR compliance, and HR management outsourcing
- [Outsourcing](https://www.theaucorp.com/outsourcing): Accounting, payroll, and finance function outsourcing
- [Arbitration Services](https://www.theaucorp.com/arbitration-services): Dispute resolution and legal advisory
- [About](https://www.theaucorp.com/about): Firm background, team, and credentials
- [Contact](https://www.theaucorp.com/contact): Contact details and inquiry form
- [Blog](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog): Regulatory explainers and India business insights
